# Superstar Returns? Spatial Heterogeneity in Returns to Housing

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Multiple Authors  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** Journal of Finance  
**DOI:** [10.1111/jofi.13479](https://doi.org/10.1111/jofi.13479)

**Keywords:** housing returns, spatial heterogeneity, real estate, superstar cities, housing investment

## Abstract

Examines spatial heterogeneity in housing returns across markets, finding that 'superstar' housing markets exhibit fundamentally different return dynamics compared to average markets, with implications for real estate investment and urban policy.
